intro1: The Deepings are about 9 miles from our workshop, and most of the homes we fit here need more storage from compact rooms.
intro2: We work in riverside stone cottages around the Market Place and in the 1970s-onwards family houses on the estates. Every kitchen, wardrobe and bedroom is measured and made to suit the room, whether that’s a busy family kitchen or wardrobes built wall to wall.
sty: Corner storage in a compact kitchen, ceiling-height sliding wardrobes or a desk in the box room: each piece is made for the space it’s going into.
proc_lead: Making takes four to six weeks once you approve the design. The Deepings are only 20 minutes up the A15, so visits and fitting can often be arranged at short notice.
steps: We measure up and check the walls. Many newer homes have stud partitions, so we plan fixings for wall and tall units before fitting day. Free, with no obligation.

det: Our showroom and workshop are in Peterborough, around 9 miles from Market Deeping. We cover homes up to 80 miles from Peterborough, so if you’re further out, call 01733 686767 and we’ll tell you straight away.
faqs: How quickly can you visit homes in the Deepings?

Usually very quickly. Market Deeping is about 9 miles from our workshop, around 20 minutes up the A15, so design visits across Market Deeping, Deeping St James and Deeping Gate are easy to fit around you.
My house is fairly new. Will fitted furniture affect the builder’s warranty?

Tell us what’s still under warranty and we’ll talk through what you’re changing at the survey, so the work doesn’t affect any cover you rely on. We also plan fixings around stud walls before we start.
How do you get more storage out of a small kitchen?
Usually with made-to-measure units in place of standard sizes, proper corner solutions, pull-out larders and, where there’s room, a slimline utility. You’ll see each option in 3D before deciding.
How much does a fitted kitchen cost?

As a guide, straightforward fitted kitchens start from around £5,000. Bigger kitchens with premium worktops and appliances cost more. The itemised quote after your free survey shows exactly what’s included.
Can I see examples before I decide?
Yes. Our showroom at 3 Brassey Close, Peterborough is about 20 minutes from the Deepings. Call 01733 686767 to arrange a visit, or ask to see photos of similar jobs at your design visit.
